name: Password Sign-In Requires TOTP
summary: The user submits valid password credentials for a TOTP-enabled durable identity; the server accepts the password proof but withholds the authenticated application session and directs the client to the canonical TOTP continuation surface.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and an active, fully configured password-enabled durable identity with TOTP enabled is ready for sign-in

inputs.name: Email
inputs.description: Prepared test-user email resolved by the server before the runner plan is returned.

inputs.name: Password
inputs.description: Valid password generated by the test setup manager and resolved by the server before the runner plan is returned.

serverInteraction.intent: Accept the submitted password for the identified durable identity, preserve the password proof without issuing an authenticated application session, and require TOTP continuation.

postconditions.expression: the durable identity remains active and anonymous to the application while password proof has succeeded and TOTP proof is still required

sourceReferences.note: RequiresTwoFactor returns AuthenticationResponseState.MfaRequired rather than completing normal sign-in.
Canonical transition preserves anonymous session capability and password proof while requiring a second factor.
Expected client destination is the canonical TOTP continuation view.
Server response AuthenticationState=8 with provider=totp is the concrete password-submit outcome that drives this scenario.
